review_candidates.title: Lawyer specializing in data protection and compliance.
review_candidates.description: Company Description Egy Law Firm is a legal practice focused on delivering high-quality, practical counsel to clients operating in data-driven and highly regulated environments. The firm advises organizations on complex legal issues, with particular emphasis on regulatory compliance, contractual risk management, and business continuity. Egy Law Firm aims to combine deep subject-matter knowledge with clear, actionable guidance that supports clients’ strategic objectives. Team members collaborate closely with clients, using technology-enabled workflows and research tools to provide efficient and timely legal services. The firm values integrity, professionalism, and ongoing learning in a supportive, inclusive work culture. Role Description This is a contract role for a Lawyer specializing in data protection and compliance. The lawyer will advise clients on data protection laws and regulations, draft and review privacy notices, data processing agreements, and compliance-related contract clauses, and assess legal risks associated with data collection, storage, transfer, and use. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing regulatory developments, preparing legal opinions and compliance guidance, supporting the design and implementation of privacy and compliance programs, and collaborating with internal and client stakeholders on incident response and regulatory inquiries. The role also involves conducting legal research, maintaining up-to-date knowledge of relevant local and international data protection frameworks, and providing clear written and verbal explanations of complex legal requirements in a business-friendly manner. Qualifications Strong knowledge of data protection and privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, Egyptian Law and Saudi Law), regulatory compliance frameworks, and contractual risk management. Experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating legal documents, including data processing agreements, privacy policies, terms of use, and service contracts. Proficiency in legal research, analysis, and writing, with the ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical guidance and policies. Ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, manage multiple matters and deadlines, and communicate clearly with both legal and non-legal stakeholders. Bachelor's Degree in Law and license to practice law in relevant jurisdiction; prior experience in a law firm or in-house role focusing on data protection or compliance is highly beneficial. Familiarity with information security concepts, incident response processes, and technology-driven business models is a plus. Commitment to ethical practice, continuous professional development, and maintaining current knowledge of evolving data protection and compliance standards.
